snapshot: WHO African Region. A two-tier system the government wants to merge through National Health Insurance, with the world's largest HIV programme adjusting to the loss of United States funding.

agenda.title: National Health Insurance despite court challenges
agenda.text: The NHI Act faces legal challenges. The minister says upgrades to public health care will continue regardless; Parliament's health committee is asking questions about NHI spending.

agenda.title: Medicine shortages
agenda.text: Shortages of dozens of essential medicines were reported in late October 2026. The Department of Health is seeking alternative products and there are calls for a parliamentary inquiry.

agenda.title: Vaccine manufacturing
agenda.text: The government is working on partnerships to strengthen domestic vaccine manufacturing.
